name: indodax-cli
description: Professional-grade MCP server and CLI for the Indodax cryptocurrency exchange. Provides real-time market data, secure OAuth-wrapped account access, spot trading, paper trading, and WebSocket event streams. Supports STDIO for desktop apps and HTTP Bridge for ChatGPT/Glama with multi-user isolation.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public HTTPS base URL of this MCP server. For the current Glama endpoint use https://glama.ai/endpoints/g5g5v8xtgn/mcp so OAuth discovery returns the correct Auth URL, Token URL, Registration URL, and Resource.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional fallback Indodax API Key for legacy header/env auth. OAuth users enter their own key during authorization instead.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional fallback Indodax API Secret for legacy header/env auth. OAuth users enter their own secret during authorization instead.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional extra bridge header secret for non-ChatGPT clients. Leave unset for ChatGPT OAuth connectors because ChatGPT will authenticate with Bearer tokens.

http.auth: OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE. Legacy x-api-key/x-api-secret headers are still supported.
